name: taste-extension
description: Save to taste: a Firefox extension that adds right-clicked images and videos to robi.work/taste.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json pnpm-lock.yaml sign.sh 'icons/*.svg' node_modules
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json pnpm-lock.yaml sign.sh 'icons/*.svg' node_modules dist
scripts.run: web-ext run --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json pnpm-lock.yaml sign.sh node_modules dist
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --ignore-files package.json pnpm-lock.yaml 'icons/*.svg' node_modules dist
